conclusion.active_finding: active probing exposes the relational witness earlier in median algorithmic steps than balanced uniform action panels
conclusion.established_in_fixture: from raw histories and a fixed grammar, the verifier selects the two-block XOR predictive quotient; controlled dynamic repair then requires the four last-two-bit suffix states while discarding lag2
conclusion.honest_null: the selected quotient matches rather than beats the raw identity predictor on heldout likelihood while using fewer predictive states
conclusion.negative_findings: passive data cannot certify an untried action; an omitted grammar and a misspecified proposal safely abstain; the semantic XOR/EQ polarity is not identified; the primary adaptive trace alone leaves two stationarity comparisons unresolved
conclusion.next_falsifiable_experiment: replace the finite Boolean truth-table grammar with typed event and sequence relations, train on one controlled family, and test whether the repaired relational state transfers unchanged to held-out tasks
conclusion.not_established: general program synthesis, language understanding, neural mechanism, open-world completeness, optimal active learning, consciousness, or superiority to existing causal and representation-learning methods

mathematical_contract.anytime_bound: each of |A|*2^h raw cells and every within-cell sample prefix n<=T receives radius sqrt(log(2M/delta)/(2n)), with M=|A|*2^h*T
mathematical_contract.candidate_order: representations are ordered by induced block count, total AST complexity, feature count, fixed grammar priority, and name
mathematical_contract.controlled_dynamic_closure: the coarsest refinement strongly lumpable for every declared action transition kernel
mathematical_contract.joint_completion: fair alternation of predictive and controlled dynamic repair reaches the same least common fixed point on the finite partition lattice
mathematical_contract.minimality: a candidate is selected only when certified and every earlier candidate is rejected; an unresolved predecessor forces abstention
mathematical_contract.predictive_sufficiency: all response laws inside each candidate block are equivalent within the merge tolerance for every declared action
mathematical_contract.proof_boundary: the confidence guarantee assumes stationary conditionally independent Bernoulli innovations per raw action/context cell; Monte Carlo is an implementation stress test, not the proof
